verdict.rationale: Mercury's first-party docs say users can pay recipients from their Mercury accounts over ACH, check, domestic wire, and international wire, with optional approval controls, and can initiate these payouts via API. The marketing site adds AI bill-pay with remembered recipients and one-click payments for permissioned users, and a long-time customer reports wire transfers working reliably. Missing for 10: detailed vendor-payment workflow documentation (limits, cutoffs, recipient setup) and independent hands-on corroboration that ACH vendor payments specifically work.
